prompt:
Some people think that new employees learn a job best by working alongside experienced colleagues from their first day. Others believe that a period of formal training away from the workplace prepares them better.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both views must be covered separately and in a balanced way, followed by a clearly stated own opinion
In favour of learning alongside experienced colleagues: seeing the real conditions of the job, questions get answered immediately, and what is learnt is put to use right away
In favour of a separate training period: basic knowledge is given in full and in order, the risk of mistakes is lower, and everyone starts from the same baseline
The own opinion must be justified: the type of job (safety-critical work, customer contact, short-term work) changes which route is suitable
At least one concrete workplace example must be given; if the two routes can be combined, how they would be combined should be explained
common_mistakes: Describing both views without ever stating an own opinion
Upsetting the balance by giving one view a full paragraph and the other just two sentences
Writing only the own opinion without discussing the other view
